description:
At Aleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
 

ChatGPT Ads by Aleph. Now local. And this is your chance to be part of it.

OpenAI has named Aleph its exclusive reseller of ChatGPT Ads in 44 countries, so brands and agencies can contract, pay and get support locally. People come to ChatGPT to learn, explore and make decisions, and ChatGPT Ads gives brands a new way to be part of those moments. At Aleph, you will help make that happen.


About the Role

As a Senior Client Partner for ChatGPT Ads by Aleph, you will advise advertisers and media agencies in the Dominican Republic on how to achieve their marketing objectives through our partner’s digital advertising platform. You will take part in the outbound sales cycle for advertising revenue: sourcing and closing new advertiser relationships, then setting them up to grow.

You will build your own pipeline, follow a disciplined sales process, and close commercial deals that turn prospects into long-term partners. You will work closely with experienced colleagues and develop your skills in consultative, new-business selling as you go.

What You Will Do

Win New Business

  • Prospect, qualify, source and close new advertising opportunities with brand advertisers and media agencies, from first engagement through contract execution.
  • Sell across a portfolio of advertising solutions, matching products to each prospect’s campaign objectives and KPI benchmarks.
  • Deliver a defined new-business revenue target within an assigned territory or vertical.
  • Prepare and negotiate commercial agreements, applying working knowledge of media agency dynamics, campaign buying, digital media planning and pricing models, with support from senior colleagues on more complex deals.

    • Build the Case

  • Quantify opportunities through clear, data-driven business cases aligned to each advertiser’s objectives.
  • Develop and carry out account and territory plans that drive advertiser ROI and long-term revenue growth.
  • Stay current on market and competitor movements, new product launches and industry events, and use that intelligence to generate new business leads.

    • Relationships and Delivery

  • Build and maintain relationships with advertising decision-makers, offering guidance and gathering their feedback.
  • Deliver an excellent sales experience throughout the cycle, resolve client issues efficiently and tactfully, and feed lessons learned back into how future issues are prevented.
  • Partner with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to ensure smooth post-sale transitions, campaign launches and coordinated expansion strategies.
  • Collaborate with support teams across the business.

    • Pipeline Discipline

  • Maintain rigorous pipeline management and CRM hygiene, with accurate weekly, monthly and annual forecasting of new business revenue.

    • What We Are Looking For

  • 4–6 years of experience in advertising sales, digital media sales, media sales or a closely related field, with a track record of winning new business.
  • Consultative thinking, ideally with exposure to a consulting environment, and the ability to understand client goals and shape proposals that meet their needs.
  • A strong new-business drive: a genuine motivation to originate and close new business, energized by winning new clients rather than only growing an existing book.
  • Solid commercial and negotiation skills, with comfort owning direct revenue responsibility and working on commercial agreements.
  • Proven ability to build and grow customer relationships, with a growing network in the advertising industry.
  • Analytical skills: comfort with analytics tools and the ability to turn data into insight, and insight into a compelling commercial narrative.
  • Good understanding of the ad-tech landscape, its underlying technology and the major players in it.
  • Project management skills to prioritize and manage multiple sales opportunities at once without losing pipeline discipline.
  • Presentation skills: the ability to pitch ideas and proposals in a concise, innovative way.
  • Operational discipline, with consistent CRM and pipeline updates and a firm grasp of your numbers.
  • Dominican Republic market knowledge and a network that helps you open conversations with advertisers.
  • A curious, adaptable mindset: you are comfortable in fast-changing environments and happy to learn as you go.
  • A positive, above-and-beyond attitude.

    • Why Join Aleph

  • Impact: Bring new advertisers in the Dominican Republic onto ChatGPT Ads and help them run their first campaigns on one of the defining platforms of the AI era.
  • Growth: Build your own pipeline and territory, learn from experienced colleagues, and grow your network and consultative selling skills.
  • Team culture: Work with CSMs and cross-functional teams who collaborate openly to turn new clients into long-term partners, in a remote setup.
  • Industry context: Help advertisers in Santo Domingo and across the Dominican Republic get more from a fast-moving digital advertising landscape, with new products and formats arriving regularly.
  • Ownership: Take real ownership of your territory or vertical, with room to shape how you win new business.

    • “Share our similarities, celebrate our differences.” – M. Scott Peck

    #ALEPH
